'''Mudrump''' is a [[Rock]] type [[DPS]] [[Critters|Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Rockhog]] at 5 stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "'The perfect Mudrump life: mud, rolling in mud, pelting anyone annoying with mud did I mention more mud?' -Mudrump's personal creed."

Mudrump is an early game, blue rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
Mudrump is a brown boar/pig. It sports a darker brown mohawk that extends to its rear, and a exaggerated unibrow of the same color. It retains typical pig features such as its snout and curly tail. It has dark brown hooves, a light tan underbelly, and a few mid-tone brown spots on its side.

== Trivia ==

* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "When this Tatari throws dirt at me, I have a poop emoji ready to throw back."
* Prior to the update on 5/13/26 its bio description said: "Mudrump loves rolling in the mud and is often covered in dirt. Also throws mud at anyone deemed annoying."
